scripts.dev: concurrently -n worker,app -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix my-app-worker" "npm run dev --prefix my-app"
scripts.dev:prod: concurrently -n worker,app -c blue,green "npm run dev:prod --prefix my-app-worker" "npm run dev:prod --prefix my-app"
scripts.sync:android:prod: npm run build:prod --prefix my-app && npm run sync --prefix my-app
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix my-app && npm install --prefix my-app-worker
